text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've come to the mountains to
get a break
from work. As I walk through
the lush greenery...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aah... Isn't this nice? Deciding to go trail
running
was a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Except you kept ducking off the beaten
path...
But you're right, this does feel
nice!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Look, Maruzen, there's a rest area
over there.
Good timing too. I could use
a snack.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, eating rice balls while
hiking the
mountain trail is poor
etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Seaweed and salt are from the sea. It's
improper
to bring items belonging to the
ocean god into
the realm of the
mountain god!

text_block_list.name: Hiker
text_block_list.text:
Um... Oh... I see. I never knew that...
Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Goodness. What a fussy person.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Chomp. Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
What?! Y-y-you there! Was that a rice
ball you
just ate?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even get a chance to stop you
before you
ate it all. Oh, C.B....

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Gulp. Mm. Can't go wrong with salmon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Be careful where you step, Maruzen! The
center
of the bridge looks safe, so stick
to it!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Hold it there! Were you not listening to
what I
just said?!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
The right way to cross a rope bridge is to
walk
humbly along the side! Tramping
through the
center makes you look like
an arrogant fool!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
In order to make sure you don't fall
while hiking
up a mountain, you should
stop and check each
of your steps
before committing to it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us! We'll just pass on ahead, if
you don't
mind. We've got to keep up a
good pace if we
want to make it all the
way up to the top.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: RRRRRGH!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
Just who do you think you are?! I've
never met
someone so selfish!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text:
That self-centered attitude of yours is
making
everyone around you
uncomfortable! Have some
common
courtesy and follow the rules!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't have to listen to the nonsense
you're
spouting.

text_block_list.name: Hiker
text_block_list.text: D-did she really just say that?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Purposely making that old rope bridge
sway was
dangerous, and you'll
overexert yourself hiking if
you don't go
at your natural pace.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But I don't really get it. Aren't you just
calling
your own personal opinions
"rules"?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So why should I do what you say? I can
think for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay, let's settle down, everyone!
Getting
upset at each other won't solve
anything. ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this trip a good one. It'd be

disrespectful to the mountain
otherwise. ♪

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Person
text_block_list.text: ...I won't forget this!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Maruzen. I overdid it again, didn't
I?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're just so blunt, is all. You
always have
to speak up about things
you don't agree with
and charge straight
into arguments.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But I like that about you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's admirable how free-spirited she is
and how
she sticks to what she believes
in, though her
strong will seems to land
her in trouble often...

what I
said is true, and to see for myself

tells me.

For example, do you feel that pleasant
breeze?
Let's sprint all the way down the
mountain now!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

Because I can't suppress this urge to go
running!

text_block_list.text:

compromise on
her beliefs may be the
secret to her strength. I
decide to see for
myself just what her running is
like.
